bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small clutches up to 4.5" x 6.5" are allowed. All bags are subject to search.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
Small clutches or wallets up to 4.5" x 6.5", with or without a strap
prohibited: Briefcases, computer bags and camera bags
Professional cameras (detachable lens), tablets and computers
bagPolicy.note: Items needed for medical reasons are allowed after inspection at entry.

parking.note: Parking is available in several lots surrounding the arena, including JPJ Garage and JPJ West, South, and East Lots. Parking passes can be purchased online or at the venue, and the arena is cashless, so plan to use credit/debit cards.

rideshare.note: For rideshare services like Uber or Lyft, use the designated cut out area off Massie Road.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at John Paul Jones Arena varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by John Paul Jones Arena, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Exiting and reentering with the same ticket is not permitted.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call is located at the John Paul Jones Arena Box Office. For ticket-related problems encountered inside the Arena, patrons should visit the back window of the box office located outside Section 308.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Complimentary hearing assistance devices are available at the Guest Services Booth (sponsored by RMC Events) located outside section 308 by the main entrance doors.
